thread:
sara_sales: Heads-up 11 prospect (mid-market payments) wants a POC for BYOK with split-key / threshold signing (n-of-m) + offline key ceremony. Theyre also asking for an option where Redwood never sees key material and third-party escrow. Any blockers?

jamal_se: We can do split-key with a threshold HSM flow. Two approaches: 1) customer-run HSMs (preferred) with our agent orchestrating threshold ops; 2) customer gives us wrapped shares via attested key ceremony endpoint. Option 1 avoids moving shares.

priya_crypto: Crypto notes: for threshold ECDSA signing we can integrate with PKCS#11-backed HSM clusters. Need to confirm supported algorithms (P-256, secp256k1?) and whether they want RSA or EC. Also ask whether the "never see" requirement includes metadata (e.g., signing counters).

sara_sales: They specifically asked for ECDSA-P256 and ledger of every sign op sent to their SIEM.

nate_ops: Ops: network-wise the POC will require outbound mTLS to their HSM gateways and inbound for our agent. If they want air-gapped ceremony we can coordinate a time-boxed jump host. We'll need maintenance window.

priya_crypto: Attestation: we can provide TPM/quote-based attestation from our agent and request vendor-signed HSM attestation from their hardware. For third-party escrow, legal will want chain-of-custody.

legal_kate: We'll need to add a Key Custody Addendum: state Redwood does not possess plaintext key shares; define procedures for joint ceremony, custody witnesses, and fees for escrow retrieval. Also add indemnity language around customer-run HSMs.

sara_sales: Pricing: they asked whether split-key increases cost. Any estimates to show them?

jamal_se: For a POC: small fixed fee + engineering hours. For production, pricing levers: dedicated connector fee, per-ceremony flat fee, and per-crypto-op premium if we proxy signing to customer HSMs. Example: $X/mo connector + $Y per-ceremony + $Z per-million sign ops. I'll draft numbers after we get expected QPS.

nate_ops: Perf note: threshold signing across remote HSMs will add latency; expect 20-50ms extra per sign depending on network. If global HA required, that goes up. We should propose a colocated witness model to reduce cross-region chatter.

jamal_se: For POC runbook I'll include test vectors: sign, verify, key-rotate (simulate lost share), and emergency-restore from escrow. Sample snippet for customer test harness:
```
# test harness (python)
from redwood_sdk import ThresholdClient
client = ThresholdClient(endpoint="https://poc.redwood.example", m=2, n=3)
resp = client.sign(b"tx-1234")
assert client.verify(resp)
```

priya_crypto: Also include a tamper-log example and SIEM webhook sample; they want HSM audit events forwarded via syslog/HTTPS.

deploy-bot: ticket created 180-POC-SPLITKEY-1805000000. Assignee: jamal_se. Due: 4 days.

sara_sales: Can we offer a "dry-run" ceremony this week? Theyre sensitive about schedule.

nate_ops: We can do a scripted dry-run in our staging infra (no real keys) and invite their security team. Need 48h notice.

legal_kate: I'll prep the addendum draft and anonymized sample SOW language.

jamal_se: I'll put together the runbook and a pricing slide. Will call out required artifacts: HSM vendor model, PKCS#11 module, SAN certs, and SIEM syslog endpoint.

sara_sales: Great. I'll confirm dates with the customer and loop in their security lead. Thanks yall :raised_hands:
